candidates.change_summary: Remove the require(callResult) check, so failed ETH transfers are not reverted.
Remove the credit[msg.sender] = 0 assignment, so credit is not cleared after withdrawal.
Remove the balance -= oCredit statement, so contract balance is not reduced on withdrawal.
Change balance -= oCredit to balance += oCredit, increasing balance instead of decreasing it.
Change credit[msg.sender] = 0 to credit[msg.sender] = 1, leaving a residual credit of 1 wei.
Replace msg.sender.call{value: oCredit} with msg.sender.call{value: oCredit + 1}, sending 1 extra wei.
Move credit[msg.sender] = 0 before balance -= oCredit, so credit is cleared before the balance deduction.
